scope: Independent bounded internal before-values opportunity/primary-prior-art/value challenge. At most two provisional questions; no new target, gene panel, raw source request, matrix row or candidate numerical outcome.

questions.question: Native EMC between-specimen bulk-RNA dispersion relative to same-source LGFMS/MLPS.
questions.source_feasibility: Favorable: actual 23,652,488B processed TPM file hash and 705-column header match all13EMC/13LGFMS/14MLPS source conditions. No RNA rows read. Fixed closest same-study cohorts genuinely exist; all13EMC remain, including recurrence/known-overlap sensitivities.
questions.primary_prior_art: The original Hofvander atlas already computes per-sample silhouette cluster-cohesion/separation scores and uses outlier profiles. Brenca already describes partner-associated native EMC transcriptional programs. Pure within-type dispersion is mathematically different and is not asserted to have been exactly answered.
questions.current_value_failure: The stated consequence that one model or biopsy may inadequately represent EMC is already motivated by known partner heterogeneity and is not established by between-patient bulk spread. A new statistic or comparative ranking alone has not supplied a useful unreported measurement decision. No finding manufactured from failure of an invented dispersion hypothesis.
questions.favorable_metadata_correction: Current cleaned704 metadata omits fusion/grade/purity, but cached primary S1 headers contain them, along with published S-score/clustering and read-depth fields. Actual per-case covariate completeness remains unexamined, not absent. No source S-score/CINSARC/purity/gene endpoint rows were read.
alternatives: Grade, handling, source/date and mean/capture dependence
Overlapping donors, recurrence and nonindependent pairwise distances
questions.reopening: An independently justified unreported disease-level question with an actual model/measurement decision, prospectively fixed gene/statistic/scale/uncertainty/disproof design and complete metadata/control handling; then root review before new values. No automatic protein prerequisite.

questions.question: Limited culture-to-native-population RNA representation versus matched other-histotype cultured/native references.
questions.scope: Owner second message arrived after initial source gate closure; this is dated reuse of already-reviewed source context and owner declared current input-set limits, not new primary authentication.
questions.favorable_use: A valid limited RNA comparison might guide choice of models for a specified transcriptional phenotype. Same-donor pairing is not universally required; this differs from previously gated donor-paired fidelity.
questions.current_readiness: Owner declares cached compatible estimated-count controls incomplete; USZ23 RefSeq TPM and other current profiles have capture/annotation/unit differences. Actual same-normalization culture controls and all-model/source links are not established in current retained processed inputs.
questions.limits: All10 sample-level supplementary NONE statements do not exclude a series-level processed file, source/API table or future public normalization path. Published PDC-to-TCGA histotype comparison is relevant prior art; adding native EMC references might be useful if it answers a specified selection decision.
questions.reopening: Focused source/value check of exact series/API processed fields and matched PDC/native control assays after current immutable audit; no random title search, new genes or RNA output mining.
